# ReelBot

> ReelBot is a movie discovery and recommendation service for finding something worth watching quickly.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://reelbot.movie/) — ask ReelBot for a movie recommendation.
- [Browse movies](https://reelbot.movie/browse) — browse current movie discovery feeds.
- [Movie collections](https://reelbot.movie/collections) — curated collections by mood, genre, era, and occasion.
- [Now playing](https://reelbot.movie/now-playing) — movies currently in theaters.
- [Trending](https://reelbot.movie/trending) — movies currently trending.
- [Coming soon](https://reelbot.movie/coming-soon) — upcoming movie releases.
- [How ReelBot works](https://reelbot.movie/how-reelbot-works) — recommendation approach and product overview.
- [Sitemap](https://reelbot.movie/sitemap.xml) — canonical discovery URLs for collections, movies, and people.

## Content

Movie detail pages use canonical `/movies/title-year` URLs. Person pages use canonical `/people/name` URLs. ReelBot provides spoiler-light movie discovery, recommendations, and curated collections.
